item.title: My Hugo First Post
item.description: So, this would be the first post of my blog. Today is 1 Sep 2026, I’m 26 years old now. I wrote this article down just 10 days before I need to fly to Canada. There is a little sadness and uncertainty. I would probably can’t go back for the next one year. I’m gonna miss my girlfriend and my parents. And Winnipeg is actually a little bit boraing there. Luckly I met Helen and Pang here, which gives me a little positive and confident to keep going.
